layers.name: Statewide Fire Stations - All Types
layers.description: Fire Stations:  Locations of all Fire and Volunteer Fire Stations across the State of Hawaiʻi as of December 2025. Source:  DOH Emergency Medical Services & Injury Prevention Branch, January 2026. All station information was gathered by DOH EMSIPSB staff members and first responder agencies throughout 2025. This layer includes the names and addresses of ALL stations, including volunteer fire stations. This data serves as a visualization of all Fire and Volunteer Fire Stations across the state for stakeholders and the public. The data is updated yearly, or as necessary. For more information, please see metadata at https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/fire_stations.pdf or contact (1) Hawaii Statewide GIS Program, Office of Planning and Sustainable Development, State of Hawaii; PO Box 2359, Honolulu, Hi. 96804; (808) 587-2846; email: gis@hawaii.gov; Website: https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis or (2) Hawaii State Department of Health, Emergency Medical Services and Injury Prevention Systems Branch; (808) 470-9530; email: julie.kobayashi@doh.hawaii.gov.

layers.name: EMS_Stations
layers.description: EMS Stations:  Locations of all EMS Stations across the State of Hawaiʻi as of December 2025. Source:  DOH Emergency Medical Services & Injury Prevention Branch, January 2026. All station information was gathered by DOH EMSIPSB staff members and first responder agencies throughout 2025. This layer includes the unit number, unit name, affiliation, latitude, longitude, and addresses of each station. This data serves as a visualization of all EMS Stations across the state for stakeholders and the public. The data is updated yearly, or as necessary. For more information, please see metadata at https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/ems_stations.pdf or contact (1) Hawaii Statewide GIS Program, Office of Planning and Sustainable Development, State of Hawaii; PO Box 2359, Honolulu, Hi. 96804; (808) 587-2846; email: gis@hawaii.gov; Website: https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis or (2) Hawaii State Department of Health, Emergency Medical Services and Injury Prevention Systems Branch; (808) 470-9530; email: julie.kobayashi@doh.hawaii.gov.
layers.copyrightText: Hawaii State Department of Health, Emergency Medical Services and Injury Prevention Systems Branch; Hawaii Statewide GIS Program

layers.name: Trauma_Centers
layers.description: Trauma Centers:  Locations of all Trauma Centers across the State of Hawaiʻi as of December 2025. Source:  DOH Emergency Medical Services & Injury Prevention Branch, January 2026. All station information was gathered by DOH EMSIPSB staff members and first responder agencies throughout 2025. This layer includes the names, addresses, and a brief overview of the services provided. Note that this map contains Trauma Centers ONLY – regular, non-trauma hospitals are not included in this analysis. The data is updated yearly, or as necessary. For more information, please see metadata at https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/fire_stations.pdf or contact (1) Hawaii Statewide GIS Program, Office of Planning and Sustainable Development, State of Hawaii; PO Box 2359, Honolulu, Hi. 96804; (808) 587-2846; email: gis@hawaii.gov; Website: https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis or (2) Hawaii State Department of Health, Emergency Medical Services and Injury Prevention Systems Branch; (808) 470-9530; email: julie.kobayashi@doh.hawaii.gov.

layers.name: Police Stations - Statewide
layers.description: Locations of police stations within the State of Hawaii as of August, 2026.Source:  Downloaded from county websites, August, 2026.  OP GIS staff geocoded Hawaii and Maui police stations from addresses available on their websites, and downloaded shapefiles from Honolulu and Kauai open data sites.  Added Hawaii County substations and mini stations manually, using prior version of layer and verifying online.  Merged county layers into one statewide layer, normalizing so that each county's attributes were included in final combined layer.  For additional information, please refer to complete metadata at https://files.hawaii.gov/dbedt/op/gis/data/policestations.pdf or contact the Hawaii Statewide GIS Program, Office of Planning and Sustainable Development, State of Hawaii; PO Box 2359, Honolulu, Hi. 96804; (808) 587-2846; email: gis@hawaii.gov; Website: https://planning.hawaii.gov/gis.
layers.copyrightText: County of Hawaii, County of Kauai, County of Maui, City and County of Honolulu, Hawaii Statewide GIS Program
